name: indolethylamine N-methyltransferase

function.text: INMT is the approved symbol for indolethylamine N-methyltransferase. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in amine N-methyltransferase activity; N-methyltransferase activity; amine metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cervical carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving INMT have been reported in cervical carcinoma and cutaneous melanoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
